articles.title: Binance hackers push $247 million through transactions designed to cloud the source
articles.snippet: Elliptic found that nearly all the mixing transactions, known as coinjoins, were coordinated by an entity called Kruw during fixed daily hours, suggesting potential handoffs to China-based money launderers.

articles.title: Fidelity Investments, Strive, Etoro join OKX-ICE tokenized securities venue
articles.snippet: The Intercontinental Exchange-backed venture said it has confirmed 113 assets for listing as trading begins, following a wave of objections from companies initially picked for inclusion.

articles.title: South Korea proposes bank-led stablecoins, 20% cap on crypto exchange stakes
articles.snippet: The draft bill would also reopen domestic initial coin offerings after a ban dating to 2017 and require issuers to disclose risks before soliciting buyers.

articles.title: Signal Calls OS-Level AI an 'Existential Threat' and Blocks Screenshots to Fight It
articles.snippet: The encrypted-messaging app will restrict screenshots on iOS 27 and auto-enable screen security on Android when it detects an AI assistant reading a chat.
